Free servers by VPN Gate volunteers · Don\'t use for banking

Pickixo VPN connects you to free public VPN servers run by volunteers of the VPN Gate Academic Experiment Project (University of Tsukuba, Japan). Pickixo is not affiliated with VPN Gate.\n\nPickixo does not collect your browsing activity. VPN Gate keeps connection logs as described in its policies.

Pickixo VPN creates a VPN connection that sends all of your phone\'s internet traffic through a free public server, so websites see that server\'s location instead of yours.

• Servers are run by volunteers of the VPN Gate Academic Experiment Project (University of Tsukuba, Japan), not by Pickixo.

• VPN Gate keeps connection logs for at least 3 months: your IP address, connection times, and the websites and IP addresses you connect to. Volunteer servers keep packet header logs for at least 2 weeks. These logs may be given to police or courts where the law allows.

• Volunteer operators can see traffic that a website does not encrypt (non-HTTPS). Don't use Pickixo VPN for banking or other sensitive accounts.

• Pickixo itself does not collect, store, share or sell your browsing activity.

• Pickixo shows ads from Google AdMob. Ads use your normal connection, not the VPN, and Google may use device identifiers. You will be asked about this separately.
Tap \"I agree\" to let Pickixo VPN route your traffic through VPN Gate servers as described above.
Pickixo VPN only works by sending your traffic through VPN Gate servers. Without your agreement the app can\'t connect. You can review the information again or exit.
